footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Interactive Brokers: after $3.4B attributable to noncontrolling interests. The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 23.4% to $2.4B in 2025. Operating income rose 29.1% to $4.8B, a 195.5% margin.
Net income rose 30.3% to $984M, or $2.22 per share. Operating cash flow was $15.8B and free cash flow $15.7B, versus $8.7B; Interactive Brokers returned $134M through dividends.
sources: Interactive Brokers Group, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
